🎬 23 Blast (2014)

23 Blast follows Travis Freeman, a talented high school football player from Corbin, Kentucky, whose promising athletic future takes an unexpected turn when a serious infection causes him to lose his eyesight. Once a rising star on his school’s football team, Travis suddenly finds himself facing challenges that threaten not only his dreams of playing football but also his confidence, independence, and sense of purpose. As he struggles to adjust to life without sight, his family, friends, and teammates encourage him to remain hopeful and rediscover his determination. Despite the enormous obstacles ahead, Travis refuses to let his disability define his future. With the support of his coach and the people closest to him, he begins an extraordinary journey toward returning to the football field. Through intense training, emotional setbacks, difficult adjustments, and moments of personal triumph, Travis discovers that courage and perseverance can overcome challenges that once seemed impossible. As his teammates rally around him, his story becomes an inspiration to the entire community, demonstrating the importance of friendship, teamwork, faith, and believing in yourself. Based on the remarkable true story of Travis Freeman, the film combines inspirational sports drama, emotional storytelling, and powerful moments of determination while celebrating resilience, hope, and the courage to pursue your dreams against overwhelming odds.

🎭 Genre: Sports • Drama • Biography • Faith-Based

⭐ IMDb: 6.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 38m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Dylan Baker
